definitions: A major tennis tournament (Australian Open, French Open, Wimbledon, or US Open).
The winning of all four major tennis tournaments in the same calendar year.
A home run hit with the bases loaded in baseball, scoring four runs.
The winning of all the games or major championships in a particular sport or competition.
A contract in bridge to take all 13 tricks.
examples: She won her first Grand Slam at the age of 19.
Only a few players have achieved the calendar Grand Slam in tennis.
He hit a grand slam in the bottom of the ninth to win the game.
The team is aiming for a Grand Slam this season.
They bid a grand slam and made it.
